data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root أ-م-ر (ʾ-m-r), 'to command'. Amīr means 'prince, commander'. Its root is أ-م-ر (ʾ-m-r). A common Arabic title and given name. Amir is a Arabic name meaning “Prince; commander; leader”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Amir expresses “Prince; commander; leader”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root أ-م-ر (ʾ-m-r), 'to command'. Amīr means 'prince, commander'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amir total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
